### 🧭 Built on Custom Content **You are one of the Flameborn of Vaaz, a race created by S'kellak, the Creator of All Things, to protect and ensure the balance of all realms.** **After thousands of years of peace, a ravenous force known as the Void has started an invasion into the universal realms. Worlds filled with life and death are now threatened with being destroyed completely.** **Will you fulfill your mission and stop the Void's Invasion?** *Prominence is a modpack built on Custom Content, based on its lore universe.* *Get ready for v4.0, the Kingdom of Vaaz Update, featuring for the first time in a Minecraft modpack a fully functional capital city filled with NPCs, which you will be able to visit at any point of the campaign, and which will evolve as you progress through the quests and eventually reach the Hasturian Era.*

⭐ Feature Overview ⭐

📜 **Quests and Story Campaign** Guide yourself through the mods with interactive quests. Explore two major storylines: **The Void's Invasion** and **The Hasturian Era**. The story campaign unlocks progressively, tying together **lore**, **narrative**, and your character's **progression**. 🌋 **The Kingdom of Vaaz** A fully fledged **capital city**, home of the **Flameborn**, **Dwarven** and **Serkonid**. 🐍 Find various NPCs with dialogues, shops and quests. ⏳ Watch it evolve with your campaign progress and change over time. 🌲 **The Talent Tree** Create your own class using a custom **Talent Tree** in Prominence's volcanic style. It features **10 fates**, **16 passive talents**, **5 active abilities**, and **100 stat talents**. Customize your build with unique talents and gear. 🔼 **Level Up Your Character** Grow stronger with a custom leveling system. Earn **talent points** every 2 levels and battle enemies that scale with your level. Includes **multiplayer support** with mob scaling. 💬 **NPC Dialogues** Two completely custom dialogue systems tied to NPCs: 🗣️ Immersive Dialogues, which contain **voice acted** (no AI used) lines and are used during campaign or important quests. 🔇 Interactive Dialogues, which use a custom screen to make players interact with the NPC, used by various NPCs across Vaaz. 🎨 **Handcrafted Design** Prominence features a distinct **volcanic visual style** crafted by **S'Kellak**. Includes a custom hotbar, custom GUI, changed textures, and a lot more immersive visual details throughout the modpack. 🔨 **Forge Your Own Endgame** Choose your own playstyle with **powerful artifacts** featuring unique abilities. Obtain the **Molten Core** through the campaign to forge artifacts. Upgrade them through their own **Upgrade Tree** by gaining Artifact Power using **Molten Remnants**. ⚔️ **The Primordial Forge: Endgame Custom Armor Sets** Forge endgame sets with unique tiered effects using the **Primordial Forge**, unlocked in Chapter II of the Hasturian Era. 💀 **Mythic Challenges: Endgame Boss Encounters** Face off against **Mythic Bosses** with **infinite scaling** difficulty, which you need to defeat before the **timer runs out**. Start at **Mythic 1** and fight increasingly harder bosses with random **affixes**. ⚠️ Up to 3 lives during multiplayer encounters; losing them makes the **Unholy Hourglass** level be reduced. 🔓 *Unlocked after completing Chapter II of the Hasturian Era.* 🧥 **Transmogrification – Choose Your Own Style** Customize the appearance of your **armor** and **weapons** using magical **Transmogrification**. # Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.1.1 - The great Rebalance Part 1**

This Update Fixes a couple of issues that have come with the latest Simply Swords update. Many weapons that have been a bit too strong are also nerfed while we are at it. Classic game devs smh... 
Items like Gh'aj were way too weak and as we all know, nerf Archer. So that is exactly what we did. Many more weapons have been made more viable, to encourage build variety. Just because your current build isnt mentioned here, doesn't mean it will never be adjusted or buffed/nerfed. There is many more planned changes. Changes are loosely grouped for each class.

We are also aware the the Wither currently does not drop Simplyswords and are working on a fix.
## Changes

### Fixes
- Temporarily using the Essential zoom(not as cool we know) until Zoomify is fixed
- Fixed OPAC UI related crash
- Simply Swords such as Sunfire can now use their Abilities again - you may need to rebind the ability button if you are still experiencing issues
- Simply Swords such as Harbinger and Lichblade now show their proper cool textures again
- Fixed Simply Bows working in claims even though they shouldn't
- Fixed Crash with Simply Skills
- Fixed an issue with Runes from Simply Swords
- Armor Stands are no longer breakable in Vaaz
- Wrenches no longer work in Vaaz
- Chorus fruit can no longer be consumed in Vaaz
- Fixed a death loop due to dying from max corruption in present and past Vaaz
  
### Additions
- Added Advanced Netherite crafting varians to blast furnace and Alloy Forge
- Added better recipes for MI barrels
- Made Advanced Netherite salvageable
- Added some more ore blocks to the Alloy Forge
- New Soulbound system:
  This replaces the old "edit an offline player's dat file if offline" approach
  Triggers if any soulbound item gets either stolen from you or you dont have enough space in inventory when receiving it

### Balance Changes
- Lowered Watcher Spell Scaling from 1.25 to 0.7
- Lowered Watcher Damage Scaling from 0.85 to 0.6
- The Watcher no longer executes everything under 25% hp, as a matter of fact it will never execute again
- Removed additional Holy Spell power from Watcher as it was not supposed to have it anymore, lol
- Made Bloodwake scale with Blood, did the same for a few other weapons such as Caelestis now scaling with Arcane
- Keep in mind that most Summons scale with healing and Soul
- Lowered Enigma Fling Upward Strength from 0.55 to 0.3, this will make mobs fly less high
- Lowered both Battle Standards to what they were supposed to have
- Lowered Winterfangs Shots count, arrow speed, homing radius, base damage, homing acceleration, bounty rune damage multiplier and extra arrow multiplier
- Simply Bows now can only have 3 Upgrades and only 2 of each
- Lowered Sindorei Heritage Draw speed bonus from +100% to +50%
- Lowered Strike Spell Scaling of Soulstalker
- Gh'aj now gives Haste and Artifact damage per node, alternating between higher artifact dmg and higher haste, middle node now gives additional 10% haste
- Supernova now gives +5% Spell haste instead of 12% Haste as it was used only for the haste by rogues
- Lowered Shadowsting Damage modifier from 1.0 to 0.66
- Lowered Shadowsting attack speed by 0.3
- Lowered Shadowsting onhit chance from 40 to 20
- Lowered Spell scaling from 2.5 to 1.75
- Increase Cooldown of the Ability from 200 to 225
- Lowered duration from 100 to 75
- Emberlash now can have twice the stacks
- Lightning weapons like Ionbound Stormscale and Mjolnir are now more viable for Valkyries and no longer scale with Physical
- Thunderbrand now scales better for both Valkyrie and Warrior
- Stormlash Rune now better scales with lightning, perfect for lightning builds
- Runic Slash Rune has been lowered to scale far less with Physical Damage and Arcane
- Dancing Blades Rune now goes up to 20, but the individual blades deal less damage
- Evocation Rune is now Unholy and scales better with it, great for mob farms 
- Lichblade now temporarily

# Prominence II: Hasturian Era
**v4.0.5 - Defensive Enchants Rebalance and Advancements fix**

This update fixes Advancements in multiplayer only being given to some players and not all of them. Players will be able to stack multiple defensive enchants(Battle Rouse, Warding, Spellbreaking and so forth) on top of their Protection. This means sacrificing another Enchanting slot for many hybrid classes, but more survivability overall. Most of these Enchantments have been lowered to be balanced. We are working on a larger update, so stay tuned for that!

## Changes

- The following Enchantments have been lowered and made non-exclusive with Protection and its brothers: Warding(Excluded from the nerf), Battle Rouse, Spellbreaking, Evasion, Defiance, Evasion, Suppression
- These Enchants can now be found, traded for and added to already existing armor without issues
- Moved Protection from Common to Rare so it is easier found in higher Arcana Enchanting Tables
- Reason as to this change is so that it appears more often in mid-late game Enchanting Table setups
- Lowered Rarities of a few less significant Enchants to replace Protection's spot like Spellbreaking and Suppression
- Disabled the Bleed mechanic from Soulsweapons entirely as it has unintended effects, this may be changed in the future
- Added more Custom Tooltips for Lord souls and Black Ocelot Pelt and more
- Added a mod to fix GLFW sometimes not working for some users
- Fixed Advancements not being given to all players that killed the boss
- Fixed NPCs in Vaaz not wanting to talk to you because of missing Advancements
- Fixed a crash for some players with the Advancement Tab
- Fixed a few formatting issues in the Minecells Tab
- Fixed Mutant Skeleton Armor buffs being accidentally enabled
- Hammers should no longer break inside claims the player doesn't own

  
## Mods
- Added Mods: Unrestricted Enchanting, GLFW X11 Fix
- Updated Mods: Opac Fixes, Mutant Skeleton Armor Tweaks
- Downgraded Mods: Better Advancements

# Prominence II Hasturian Era
v3.9.20 Guns and Demons

A **new subclass** just dropped! Guns are now an early to mid game alternative to Bows and crossbows. These Guns scale with ranged damage, but need a ton of ammo! Here is the first four horsemen!

- Gatling gun: 20 second spin time, decent dps but it will slow you down and is a bit inaccurate
- Hunter Cannon: Big boom! This weapon has the highest single target Damage out of them all, with a large cooldown!
- Hunter Blunderbuss: A general jack of all trades, shoots 3 projectiles each doing decent damage and having the highest Velocity out of them all, not the most accurate
- Hunter Pistol: The Blunderbuss' smaller brother is great for anyone who likes to shoot fast and having something to do whilst the other guys are reloading

All of these work **with Infinity**, so dont worry about Ammo later on!
*Why would i care about these, im a Warrior!!?*
These guns **aren't only for Ranged Classes**! Guns come with unique enchants that can compliment **other playstyles!**

- Tether Pulls an opponent(or friend if you fell silly) closer to you, just not all the way
- Chain Lightning gives the guns a smaller AOE effect that can take care of large masses.
